messages:
Tori: Quick sync from today's Starlight Labs interview. Need before publish: signed release, one homepage pull quote, two tweet-length lines, and a decision on webinar participation. Assets + raw audio: https://drive.google.com/starlight-interview :sparkles:

Evan: They said "half the inference cost" vs their previous setup but asked we not name the prior vendor. Prefer anonymized phrasing.

Priyanka (CS): Tech pull: prefix-cache + smaller quantized model did most of the cost wins. I can draft the 1-liner.

Marta (Legal): Please send our release template. If we use approximate language ("~2x" or "about 50% lower") that's OK; naming a vendor needs extra verification. Uploaded redline: https://drive.google.com/open?id=starlight-release

Evan: Sent quote options to their marketing lead. They replied and attached signed release, asked we use "about 2x" and confirm no vendor names. Attached: https://drive.google.com/file/d/starlight-signed.pdf

Marta (Legal): Reviewed and cleared: approved quote "Redwood lowered our inference cost by about 2x while improving tail latency." Cleared for blog, social, and webinar promo.

Tori: Great. Priyanka, please paste the tech line and two social blurbs in the doc. Ops, set HubSpot tag=case-study/starlight, owner=NA_SDRs and attach the signed release + transcript to any inbound.

Priyanka (CS): Pasted: 
- Tech line: "Prefix caching + quantization reduced tail latency and cost at scale."
- Tweet 1: "Starlight Labs cut inference spend ~2x after moving to Redwood."
- Tweet 2: "Faster tail latency and simpler ops let us ship iteration faster."

OpsBot: HubSpot rule created. Tag=case-study/starlight, owner=NA_SDRs. Release + transcript attached automatically.

Tori: I'll make the quote graphic and schedule the short launch post for Tue AM. Evan  add the webinar ask in the invite if they're available. Closing once assets are in Drive. Thanks all!
